headline: After rebound, Kospi jumps 3% – will it keep gaining momentum and raise its highs? (comprehensive)
summary: The Kospi rose 3% after a rebound, helped by US chip gains, with Samsung up 2.5% and SK Hynix up 5.8%. Foreign investors net bought 1.4514 trillion won of Kospi shares, and the Kosdaq rose four straight days.
why: The Kospi is South Korea's main benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Its moves are closely watched as a gauge of global chip demand.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index rose 3% in the session, as stated in the report.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The report links the gains to US chip-sector tailwinds, with foreign investors net buying Kospi shares.
